name: Go
subtitle: Compiled server language (net/http, Gin, Echo)
creator: Robert Griesemer, Rob Pike and Ken Thompson at Google
description: A simple, statically typed language that compiles to single native binaries. Goroutines and channels make concurrency cheap, and the standard library ships a production-grade HTTP server. Gin and Echo add routing sugar and middleware on top.

concepts.explanation: Code organized by package, versioned with go.mod.
Implemented implicitly by any type with the right methods.
Lightweight threads started with the go keyword.
Typed pipes for passing data between goroutines.
Functions return an error you check explicitly.
Carry deadlines and cancellation through calls.
One file to deploy, easy cross-compilation.
